brand.name: Stripe
brand.summary: Stripe is a comprehensive financial services platform that enables businesses of all sizes to accept online and in-person payments, build flexible billing models, and manage global money movement. It provides scalable developer tools, anti-fraud protection, and embedded financial infrastructure for startups and global enterprises.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: Stripe is a market leader in online payment processing and financial infrastructure, offering modular solutions for billing, card issuing, fraud prevention, and cross-border commerce.

competitors.opportunity: Target businesses seeking deeply embedded, highly customizable checkout experiences.
